evidence: Of the 5 human cancer cell lines examined, ME180 cells were the most radiosensitive, but their level of DAPK protein expression was undetectable by western blotting.

A comparative study of ME180 cells with 2 other uterine cancer cell lines, HHUA and HOKUG, revealed no significant relationships between cellular radiosensitivity and DAPK protein expression or hypermethylation of the DAPK promoter CpG island.
